8	/-!
9	# A curve that satisfies the B3 hypotheses: `ℙ¹` itself
10	
11	`Picard/RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange.lean` proves `Scheme.HasRigidPushforward C` for every
12	`C : Over (Spec k)` that is smooth of relative dimension one, proper and geometrically integral.
13	A theorem quantified over those three hypotheses is worth nothing if the tree contains no object
14	satisfying them, so this file exhibits one — the projective line over an arbitrary field — and
15	fires the gate at it (`hasRigidPushforward_p1Over`).
16	
17	Two instances are needed, and neither is bookkeeping: both are named in the tree as *open*.
18	
19	* **§1, geometric integrality.**  `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1Constants.lean`'s
20	  `p1TrivialConstants_of_proj` calls `GeometricallyIntegral (Proj ℤ[X₀,X₁] ⟶ ⊤_Scheme)` "the
21	  *whole* remaining B3-H0 frontier" and "a missing mathlib fact about `Proj`".  It follows in a
22	  dozen lines from material that landed after that docstring was written:
23	  `Adelic.instIsIntegralP1OverLeft` (`Picard/RigidPushforwardInstance.lean`) says `ℙ¹_K` is an
24	  integral scheme for **every** field `K`, which is exactly what geometric integrality of the
25	  integral model asks — the base scheme of the test square is terminal, so the test map `y` is
26	  `Subsingleton.elim`'d away and the test object is *isomorphic* to `(p1Over K).left`.
27	
28	* **§2, smoothness of relative dimension one.**  Also unproduced before this file.  The two
29	  standard charts have polynomial section rings
30	  (`p1ChartSectionsAlgEquivX`/`Y`, `Picard/RigidPushforwardP1ChartSections.lean`), a polynomial
31	  ring in one variable is standard smooth of relative dimension one over its base (§2.1, via
32	  `SubmersivePresentation` with one generator and no relations), and the charts cover
33	  (`p1Chart_sup_eq_top`).
34	
35	Together with the existing `Adelic.isProper_p1Over_hom` this discharges the whole hypothesis
36	bundle, so §3's `hasRigidPushforward_p1Over` is `inferInstance`.
37	
38	## What this does and does not settle
39	
40	It settles **non-vacuity**: the B3 headlines are not statements about the empty class of curves.
41	It does **not** claim that `ℙ¹` is the curve the Jacobian challenge is about — the challenge's
42	curve has genus ≥ 1 and its own hypotheses (`references/challenge.lean` states them with
43	`GeometricallyIrreducible` rather than `GeometricallyIntegral`; the two agree here because
44	`Curve/GeometricallyReduced.lean`'s `Smooth.geometricallyIntegral` bridges them, which is why
45	`Picard/RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange.lean` imports that file).
46	
47	## On registering these as global instances
48	
49	Inbox `I-0432` warns against registering a discharged gate as a global instance when an instance
50	*diamond* is live nearby, because a global instance fires inside every downstream statement and
51	that is exactly when the wrong branch of a diamond gets picked.  The warning does not bite here,
52	and the reason is structural rather than a survey: every class instantiated globally in this file
53	and in `Picard/RigidPushforwardGammaBaseChange.lean` — `Scheme.HasRigidPushforward`,
54	`SmoothOfRelativeDimension`, `GeometricallyIntegral`,
55	`Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension` — is **`Prop`-valued**, so any two instances of it
56	are equal by proof irrelevance and no choice of branch can change what a downstream statement
57	*means*.
58	
59	The one data-valued instance in this file, the `k`-algebra structure on a chart section ring, is
60	exactly where a diamond *could* live, and it is `local` — re-declared verbatim from
61	`Picard/RigidPushforwardP1ChartSections.lean`, which in turn re-declares it verbatim from
62	`RiemannRoch/Adelic/P1ChartData.lean`.  That chain is why `p1ChartSectionsAlgEquivX` type-checks
63	against it: same term, not merely the same shape.
64	
65	Sources: Stacks 01MZ (`Proj` of a graded ring), 00T2 (standard smooth ring maps); mathlib
66	`AlgebraicGeometry/AffineSpace.lean` has the affine analogue of §1.

97	    (terminal.from (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) := by
98	  constructor
99	  intro K _ y Z fst snd hsq
100	  have hflip : IsPullback
101	      (pullback.snd (terminal.from (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
102	        (terminal.from (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)))))
103	      (pullback.fst (terminal.from (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
104	        (terminal.from (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)))))
105	      (terminal.from (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ))))
106	      (terminal.from (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) :=
107	    (IsPullback.of_hasPullback _ _).flip
